SELECT id, config_id, line_supplier, lines_info, price, effect_start_date, effect_end_date, enabled, create_time, update_time, is_delete FROM b_marketing_line_account_record
is_delete =0
AND line_supplier LIKE CONCAT('%', #{lineSupplier}, '%')
AND lines_info LIKE CONCAT('%', #{callerFullName}, '%')
AND price = #{price}
AND #{nowDate} BETWEEN effect_start_date AND effect_end_date
